visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a pink bikini top and multiple bracelets, stands in a hotel bedroom. She holds a large pink product bag and gestures excitedly while speaking. The background shows a bed with white linens and a wall with floral art. (2) She transitions to holding a smaller pink sachet (POPO JELLY) and uses her hands to tear the packaging open near her face. (3) A graphic screen appears with a yellow background and red/black text displaying 'Point.01' and benefits of African Mango extract, momentarily replacing the camera view. (4) The woman is seen again, bringing the sachet to her lips and sucking the jelly contents out while looking into the lens. (5) An insert shot shows a hand squeezing the dark jelly from the pink sachet into a glass filled with yellow liquid and a gold straw. (6) Back in the room, she continues her energetic presentation, holding the sachet and gesturing with her hands to describe its effects. (7) A tighter close-up of her face shows her consuming the jelly once more with a satisfied expression. (8) She concludes the video by speaking directly to the camera, gesturing with both hands to mention upcoming sales events, set against the same hotel room background.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long light brown hair, wearing a mauve pink bikini top, several beaded bracelets on both wrists, and light makeup.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A hotel room with a neatly made bed, white sheets, and a beige/cream headboard. The wall features traditional-style floral wallpaper (plum blossoms).

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An energetic female voice begins speaking in Mandarin at a high volume and fast rate, with an enthusiastic and friendly pitch contour. Background music (BGM) featuring an upbeat electronic synth beat and steady percussion is active. (2) A sharp 'plastic rustle' incidental noise is heard as the presenter tears open the foil sachet. The vocal continues without pause, maintaining a high arousal level and clear articulation. (3) The speaker details the product benefits with a consistent high-pitched tone; the music remains steady and upbeat, providing a rhythmic bed for the high-density speech. (4) Soft slurping sounds are briefly audible as she consumes the jelly, accompanied by slight vocal pauses before resuming rapid-fire narration about the ingredients. (5) The final segment features the speaker announcing 'group buy' dates (June and July) with a persuasive, rising intonation. The BGM maintains its tempo until a hard cut at the end of the clip.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem/Solution -> Evidence -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional endorsement for a diet jelly product. The creator uses her fit physique as visual evidence, highlights key ingredients via on-screen graphics, and shares her personal consumption habits to build trust. It ends with specific 'group buy' information to drive sales and follower engagement.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, verbal recommendation of the brand 'POPO JELLY', and announcement of a scheduled group buy/sale event.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-energy 'influencer' style, combining visual proof (the creator's appearance) with technical data (mango extract graphics) to create a high-conversion sales pitch for beauty/wellness products.
